summary: The lab of the week: Dockerfiles for the gateway and the page, an nginx file that serves the page and forwards /api/ to the gateway, and one Compose file with five services where only the page publishes a port. Checked for real without an engine: docker compose config and its errors, the gateway built and run by hand with its Python address from the environment, and the page built by hand. No image was built; your run is the first real one, and the README says what you ran.
goal: M13 part 1: one command starts React, ASP.NET Core, Python and PostgreSQL.

items.text: Write the page Dockerfile, the .dockerignore and nginx.conf
Write compose.yaml with five services and check it with docker compose config
Run docker compose down -v, then docker compose up -d --build, and ask a question at http://localhost:8080
Check that only port 8080 is published and that .env is not in Git
Write the README section with what you ran and what you did not
Play the Whole System Check game to the end and see your score
